How Each Robot Is Built

The Trait System

Every robot keeps the same essential form — the cube head, the single gem eye, the W pendant. Everything around that core varies: the gem, the headpiece, the metal, the ornament, the dark behind it.

Gem Eyes × 15

One gem, set at the centre of the cube, is the robot's eye and its soul. Fifteen stones across the collection:

RubySapphireEmerald DiamondAmethystCitrine TopazPeridotAquamarine TanzaniteSpinelOnyx GarnetOpalTourmaline

Headpieces × 15

Wings are only five of the fifteen — the rest are mechanical and ceremonial fittings mounted on the cube:

GearsAntennaCrown HaloHornsPipes Crystal GrowthSpeaker Wrench & DriverFan Wings × 5 variants

Metals × 4

The ornament is struck in one of four metals. Platinum is reserved for the Mythic tier.

GoldPlatinum Rose GoldBlackened Gold

Ornament & Ground × 8 / × 9

Eight ornament themes are engraved across the cube — baroque scrollwork, leaf & vine, moon & star, snowflake, fleur-de-lis and more — each robot grounded against one of nine dark backgrounds, from Charcoal and Bottle Green to Burgundy and Indigo.

64,800 Combinations

The full trait space holds 64,800 possible robots. Only 4,000 were curated into the collection — the rest were never struck.
